description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Noctis (Fire)], [Steel Pirouette Ability Tracker] and [Steel Pirouette Level]

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Noctis (Fire)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Steel Pirouette (0~2), removed after using Steel Pirouette two times

description.name: Steel Pirouette Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Steel Pirouette level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Fire abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Noctis (Fire)]

description.name: Steel Pirouette Level
description.text: Keeps track of Steel Pirouette level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Noctis (Fire)]
